projects.name: Smart E-commerce Platform
projects.description: Large-scale e-commerce platform based on microservices architecture, supporting millions of concurrent users with integrated AI recommendation system.
projects.detailedDescription: This is a complete enterprise-level e-commerce solution designed with microservices architecture, including core modules such as user management, product catalog, order processing, payment system, inventory management, and logistics tracking. The system uses .NET Core as the backend framework and React as the frontend technology stack, supporting high concurrent access and elastic scaling. Integrated machine learning recommendation algorithms to provide users with personalized product recommendation services.

projects.name: Enterprise Project Management System
projects.description: Modern project management platform supporting agile development workflows, integrated CI/CD pipelines and real-time collaboration features.
projects.detailedDescription: A fully-featured enterprise project management system supporting agile development methodologies, including requirements management, task assignment, progress tracking, team collaboration, and document management. The system adopts a front-end and back-end separation architecture, using .NET Core Web API for the backend and Vue.js for the frontend. Integrated with GitLab CI/CD, supporting automated deployment and testing. Provides rich reporting and data analysis capabilities to help project managers make data-driven decisions.

projects.name: Real-time Data Analytics Platform
projects.description: Big data real-time processing and visualization platform, supporting multi-data source integration and custom dashboards.
projects.detailedDescription: A powerful real-time data analysis and visualization platform capable of processing massive data streams from multiple data sources. The system adopts an event-driven architecture, uses Apache Kafka for message queue processing, and ClickHouse as a time-series database, supporting millisecond-level data query response. The frontend provides a drag-and-drop dashboard designer where users can customize various charts and reports. Integrated machine learning algorithms supporting anomaly detection and trend prediction.

projects.name: Smart Customer Service Bot
projects.description: Intelligent customer service system based on natural language processing, supporting multi-turn conversations and knowledge base management.
projects.detailedDescription: An intelligent customer service bot system integrated with natural language processing technology, capable of understanding user intent and providing accurate responses. The system uses BERT models for semantic understanding, supporting multi-turn conversations and context memory. Includes knowledge base management, conversation flow design, customer service ticketing system and other functions. Supports multi-channel integration, including web chat, WeChat, DingTalk and other platforms.

projects.name: Blockchain Voting System
projects.description: Decentralized voting platform based on Ethereum, ensuring transparency and immutability of the voting process.
projects.detailedDescription: A decentralized voting system based on blockchain technology, using smart contracts to ensure transparency and immutability of the voting process. The system supports multiple voting types, including single choice, multiple choice, ranked voting, etc. Provides complete voting lifecycle management, from vote creation, candidate management to result statistics. Integrated digital identity verification to ensure the fairness of one person, one vote.
